# llms-txt

> The /llms.txt file, helping language models use your website

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/llms-txt): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](http://llmstxt.org/): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
